name: Place Builder
description: Build a small or medium outdoor place (camp, croft row, shrine, graveyard, landing, work yard, den, watch ruin, halt yard, cuttings) from a place archetype + the zone brief + the reservation + the measured ground: plan the job dir, build it in a lab copy of the world, run every install gate, take the pictures, install with an inverse. Loose props go through dressing plans, never transforms. CLI: apps/playground/tools/place-build.mts; docs/place-builder.md.
